rows.grounds: fused sandhi form; optative of prajap with yatnatas

items.question: What condition does the goddess require for mantra recitation to succeed?
premises: recitation must be performed with effort
no other way leads to success
success is certain when done so
items.inference: Effortful recitation is the necessary condition for success.
uncertainties: sandhi fusion in first token is not expanded
items.plain_english: O goddess, one should recite with effort; otherwise it does not succeed; certainly.
